{{Short description|Indian mathematician (1933-2012)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=February 2020}}
{{Use Indian English|date=April 2017}}
'''Daya-Nand Verma''' (25 June 1933, [[Varanasi]] – 10 June 2012, [[Mumbai]]<ref name=obit/>) was a mathematician at the [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]] during the period 1968-1993. The construction of [[Verma module]]s appears in his Ph.D. thesis as a student of [[Nathan Jacobson]] at [[Yale University]].<ref name=obit>Arun Ram [https://math.soimeme.org/~arunram/Publications/120911Vermamemory.pdf D-N. VERMA (1933-2012): A MEMORY] ms.unimelb.edu.au</ref>

==Select publications==
*{{citation|last=Verma|first=Daya-Nand|title=Structure of certain induced representations of complex semisimple Lie algebras, Yale Univ., dissertation, 1966 |publisher=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. Volume 74, Number 1|year=1968|pages=160–166}}.
*{{citation|last=Verma|first=Daya-Nand|title=Mobius inversion for the Bruhat ordering on a Weyl Group|publisher=Ann. Sci. Ecole Norm. Sup. 4e Serie, t.4|year=1971|pages=393–398}}.
*{{citation|last=J.E.Humphreys and D.N.Verma|title=Projective Modules for finite Chevalley Groups |publisher=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. Volume 79|year=1973|pages=467–468}}.
*{{citation|last=Verma|first=Daya-Nand|title=Role of Affine Weyl groups in the representation theory of Chevalley groups and their Lie algebras in ''Lie Groups and their Representations'', ed. I.M.Gelfand|publisher= Halsted, New York|year=1975|pages=653–705}}.
